cs.t: I was skeptical of my Yamakasi 4k monitor. But it has turned out well. Just over $300 for 4k. It is obvious that it is actually 2 different panels on the inside. At one point after being on for a while, the two didn't line up. Rebooting the monitor fixed it. Yup. Monitor needed a reboot. But I can't complain for $300.
cs.th: Ask HN: What is an affordable 4k monitor?
